data.name: Within The Box
data.detailed_description:
Ever wanted a Fantasy Survival Horror? Inspired by Resident Evil and Classic Dungeons and Dragons, Within The Box let's you play as one of two respected mages tracking down a rogue wizard only to get stuck in his pocket dimension. Solve puzzles, sling magic, and uncover the truth to find a way out.

In Within The Box you'll find a first person, tense exploration, and puzzle solving gameplay that may be more akin to your Saturday Night Dungeons & Dragons game than an old playthrough of Resident Evil. You have a choice between the eccentric and studious Astair Volken or the wise-cracking and shoot first, ask questions later Zenner Jackson, who are tasked with tracking down a powerful rogue wizard named Raven and the important documents he stole from a local Magical Institution known as the Cypher. Only to find the tower he was hiding out in abandoned, after triggering a trap within the tower, both were teleported into a pocket dimension designed by Raven, and need to find a way out.

  • A unique survival horror dungeon crawler experience - Navigate dark and mysterious levels with hidden secrets, locked doors that require a keen mind to open, and areas crawling with twisted creatures that will test your resolve.

  • Inventory management - Limited inventory space for both characters will ensure that each item pickup makes for interesting choices and proper planning to be successful. 

  • Two unique campaigns – Uncover the story of both Astair and Zenner as they navigate through the box with two completely unique storylines and playstyles that weave together seamlessly.

  • Two unique playstyles - Both Astair and Zenner play wildly differently. Will you enjoy the slow and tense survival horror action of Astair and his wand based attacks, Or the the faster-paced and heart pumping action of Zenner with his twin enchanted pistols.

  • Navigate the twisted horrors – A wide variety of twisted creatures stalk the rooms and pathways of the box. From twisted monstrosities, spiders, awakened gargoyles, and who knows what else has been let loose.

  • Speedruns and Replayability – Playthroughs are timed and scored at the end of each campaign, encouraging replayability and speedrunning built-in. 

  • New Game Plus - Enjoy new runs with fully unlocked weapons and upgrades for both characters to push new playthroughs to the next level.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (6th Gen) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel UHD 620 / Vega 8) or Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM DirectX 11 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th Gen) or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
